title: Unpaid catering for product launch
description: We catered Vantage Media's product launch for 80 people in February 2026. We agreed the menu and price of £3,400 by phone with their events manager. We sent an invoice due 31 March 2026 but it has not been paid. We do not have a signed contract and have not sent any formal letter yet.
notes: No documents at all. Every fact must cite the client description (document 0). Score should be low.
